<script setup lang="ts">
import type { MenubarProps } from '@vase-ui/vue/menubar'
import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'vue'

  class?: HTMLAttributes['class']

</script>

  <Menubar
    data-slot="menubar"
    :class="cn('h-8 rounded-2xl border p-[3px] flex items-center', props.class)"
  >
    <slot />
  </Menubar>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { MenuPopupProps, MenuPositionerProps } from '@vase-ui/vue/menu'
import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'vue'
import { Menu } from '@vase-ui/vue/menu'
import { cn } from 'cn'

interface Props extends /* @vue-ignore */ MenuPopupProps {
  class?: HTMLAttributes['class']
  side?: MenuPositionerProps['side']
  sideOffset?: MenuPositionerProps['sideOffset']
  align?: MenuPositionerProps['align']
  alignOffset?: MenuPositionerProps['alignOffset']
}

defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
})

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<Props>(), {
  side: 'bottom',
  sideOffset: 8,
  align: 'start',
  alignOffset: -4,
})

function onBeforeEnter(el: Element) {
  el.removeAttribute('data-closed')
  el.setAttribute('data-open', '')
}

function onBeforeLeave(el: Element) {
  el.removeAttribute('data-open')
  el.setAttribute('data-closed', '')
}
</script>

<template>
  <Menu.Portal>
    <Menu.Positioner
      :side="side"
      :side-offset="sideOffset"
      :align="align"
      :align-offset="alignOffset"
      class="isolate z-50 outline-none"
    >
      <Transition @before-enter="onBeforeEnter" @before-leave="onBeforeLeave">
        <Menu.Popup
          data-slot="menubar-content"
          v-bind="$attrs"
          :class="cn('bg-popover text-popover-foreground data-open:animate-in data-open:fade-in-0 data-open:zoom-in-95 data-[side=bottom]:slide-in-from-top-2 data-[side=left]:slide-in-from-right-2 data-[side=right]:slide-in-from-left-2 data-[side=top]:slide-in-from-bottom-2 ring-foreground/5 dark:ring-foreground/10 min-w-36 rounded-2xl p-1 shadow-lg ring-1 duration-100 data-[side=inline-start]:slide-in-from-right-2 data-[side=inline-end]:slide-in-from-left-2 cn-menu-target cn-menu-translucent z-50 origin-(--transform-origin) overflow-hidden', props.class)"
        >
          <slot />
        </Menu.Popup>
      </Transition>
    </Menu.Positioner>
  </Menu.Portal>
</template>

<script lang="ts">
import type { InjectionKey } from 'vue'

export const menubarGroupKey: InjectionKey<boolean> = Symbol('menubarGroup')
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { MenuGroupProps } from '@vase-ui/vue/menu'
import { Menu } from '@vase-ui/vue/menu'
import { provide } from 'vue'

interface Props extends /* @vue-ignore */ MenuGroupProps {}

defineProps<Props>()

provide(menubarGroupKey, true)
</script>

<template>
  <Menu.Group data-slot="menubar-group">
    <slot />

</template>

interface Emits extends /* @vue-ignore */ MenuRootEmits {}

<template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { MenuPopupProps, MenuPositionerProps } from '@vase-ui/vue/menu'
import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'vue'
import { Menu } from '@vase-ui/vue/menu'
import { cn } from 'cn'

interface Props extends /* @vue-ignore */ MenuPopupProps {
  class?: HTMLAttributes['class']
  side?: MenuPositionerProps['side']
  sideOffset?: MenuPositionerProps['sideOffset']
  align?: MenuPositionerProps['align']
  alignOffset?: MenuPositionerProps['alignOffset']
}

defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
})

const props = defineProps<Props>()

function onBeforeEnter(el: Element) {
  el.removeAttribute('data-closed')
  el.setAttribute('data-open', '')
}

function onBeforeLeave(el: Element) {
  el.removeAttribute('data-open')
  el.setAttribute('data-closed', '')

    <Menu.Positioner
      :side="side"
      :side-offset="sideOffset"
      :align="align"

      class="isolate z-50 outline-none"

      <Transition @before-enter="onBeforeEnter" @before-leave="onBeforeLeave">
        <Menu.Popup
          data-slot="menubar-sub-content"
          v-bind="$attrs"
          :class="cn('bg-popover text-popover-foreground data-open:animate-in data-closed:animate-out data-closed:fade-out-0 data-open:fade-in-0 data-closed:zoom-out-95 data-open:zoom-in-95 data-[side=bottom]:slide-in-from-top-2 data-[side=left]:slide-in-from-right-2 data-[side=right]:slide-in-from-left-2 data-[side=top]:slide-in-from-bottom-2 ring-foreground/5 dark:ring-foreground/10 min-w-32 rounded-2xl p-1 shadow-lg ring-1 duration-100 data-[side=inline-start]:slide-in-from-right-2 data-[side=inline-end]:slide-in-from-left-2 cn-menu-target cn-menu-translucent z-50 origin-(--transform-origin) overflow-hidden', props.class)"
        >
          <slot />
        </Menu.Popup>
      </Transition>
    </Menu.Positioner>
  </Menu.Portal>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { MenuTriggerProps } from '@vase-ui/vue/menu'
import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'vue'
import { Menu } from '@vase-ui/vue/menu'
import { cn } from 'cn'
import { computed, useTemplateRef } from 'vue'

interface Props extends /* @vue-ignore */ MenuTriggerProps {
  class?: HTMLAttributes['class']
}

const props = defineProps<Props>()

const part = useTemplateRef<{ element: Element | null }>('part')
// An outer trigger that renders this wrapper in its element slot reads the element of the part.
defineExpose({ element: computed(() => part.value?.element ?? null) })
</script>

<template>
  <Menu.Trigger
    ref="part"
    data-slot="menubar-trigger"
    :class="cn('hover:bg-muted aria-expanded:bg-muted rounded-2xl px-1.5 py-[2px] text-sm font-medium flex items-center outline-hidden select-none', props.class)"
  >
    <template v-if="$slots.element" #element="slotProps">
      <slot name="element" v-bind="slotProps" />
    </template>
    <slot />
  </Menu.Trigger>
</template>

export { default as Menubar } from './Menubar.vue'
export { default as MenubarCheckboxItem } from './MenubarCheckboxItem.vue'

export { default as MenubarSubContent } from './MenubarSubContent.vue'
export { default as MenubarSubTrigger } from './MenubarSubTrigger.vue'
export { default as MenubarTrigger } from './MenubarTrigger.vue'
